Subject: Invoice cutover: draft drawdown timetable & VAT evidence requested

Hi Sam / Olivia,

Following up from our call — attaching a draft invoice/drawdown timetable so your finance team can confirm cadence and VAT routing. Key asks: please confirm (by next Wed 2027-04-14) the preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs. quarterly), the kickoff invoice date you want on the ledger, and whether you can supply a VAT certificate for EU reverse-charge handling (if applicable).

Attached: 2027-04-10-acme-invoice-schedule.xlsx (draft) — includes proposed monthly withdrawals tied to your committed spend milestones.

Notes:
- We recommend monthly invoices to smooth cashflow and match consumption patterns; we can also do quarterly if that aligns better with your AR.
- If you need upfront credits swept into escrow and a monthly drawdown, call that out and we will include an escrow routing step in the first invoice.

Next steps for our side once we hear back: finalize the invoice PDF, prepare the signed SOW for countersignature, and provide wire details or a payment portal link.

Thanks,

--

1) Can we start the drawdown on 2027-05-01 rather than the 15th? That aligns with our monthly close.
2) We prefer monthly invoices.
3) I can attach the VAT certificate but will need to confirm whether our AP needs the certificate on the invoice PDF or uploaded separately to our vendor portal.

Also — small ask on the invoice breakdown: can you add a single-line summary for committed credit remaining after each drawdown? Helps our reporting.

Appreciate the quick reply, Sam. Confirming:

- Kickoff drawdown: 2027-05-01 (we will cut the invoice on 2027-04-25 with Net30 terms).
- Cadence: monthly.
- We will add a single-line "Committed credit balance" row after each drawdown in the schedule.

I attached an updated schedule (same filename) with the balance column and the March baseline consumption row so you can see projected remaining credits after each monthly withdrawal.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-2027-ACME-09 — I'm linking the PO and SOW there for your procurement team.

Action items for your team: please upload the VAT certificate (acme-vat-certificate.pdf) to this thread or your vendor portal and confirm whether you need us to embed it in the invoice PDF. If AP needs wire instructions, we will include them on the finalized invoice and in the email to your AR contact.

--
Priyom

Thanks, Olivia / Sam — received the SOW and VAT cert. Confirming final ops plan: 

1) Invoice cadence: monthly. First invoice will be issued 2027-04-25 with an invoice date for reporting purposes of 2027-05-01 and Net30 payment terms.
2) Drawdown matrix: we will withdraw committed credits monthly per the attached schedule (2027-04-10-acme-invoice-schedule.xlsx). Each invoice will include a line item "Committed credit balance" showing remaining credits post-withdrawal.
3) PO handling: please provide the PO number when you receive the invoice; we will include it in the invoice reference and on the wire instructions.
4) Wire details: Redwood bank — First Western Bank, routing 123456789, acct 987654321, reference: ACME-DEAL-2027-09-<PO>. Karthik, please confirm if we should use the escrow account for the first sweep (Acme requested escrow option).
4b) Payment portal: we will also send a secure payment link in the invoice email if AP prefers card/ACH.

Action items and owners:
- Acme (Olivia/Sam): upload PO number to thread and confirm if VAT cert should be embedded in invoice PDF (Due: 2027-04-20).
- Karthik: confirm wire/escrow account to print on invoice (Due: 2027-04-19).
- Marissa/Grace: finalize invoice template with committed-balance row and GL mapping (Due: 2027-04-22).

I'll post the finalized invoice and payment link once Karthik confirms the wire/escrow details. Thanks everyone — seems we're on track for the May 1 drawdown.

Best,
